summary: Palm Jumeirah and ultra luxury listings are a strength, but placeholder text, mixed up prices and a broken contact link appear to cost you serious buyers.

findings.problem: The public email contactus@luxuryresidences.com appears wrapped in a phone link, and the page appears to show both 'Thank you! Your submission has been received!' and 'Oops! Something went wrong while submitting the form.'
findings.cost: A buyer who clicks the email opens the dialer and a form that looks broken sends enquiries nowhere.
findings.fix: Working email link and a clean enquiry form.

findings.problem: Listings appear to show 'This is some text inside of a div block.', 'Heading' and a Placeholder Image file name.
findings.cost: Template text on a multi million dirham page destroys luxury trust.

findings.problem: Prices appear mismatched, such as AED 38,000,000 beside $ 38,000,000 and 6,702 sq.ft beside 63 sq.m, and apartments appear labelled as 'Duplex Bespoke Garden Home' and 'Garden Villa'.
findings.cost: Wrong prices and sizes make buyers doubt every listing.
findings.fix: Verified prices, sizes and property types.

findings.problem: The Insights section appears to repeat the same Bugatti Residences 2023 card four times with # links, the footer shows 2024 and 2026, and Privacy Policy appears to link to #.
findings.cost: Stale repeated content and a dead privacy link signal an unattended site.
findings.fix: Fresh insights, current footer, real policy page.

redesign: Working email, WhatsApp and enquiry form.
Clean listings with verified prices and sizes.
Fresh insights and real policy pages.
